{{Quote|He's mowing through Zygerrians like frond grass...|[[Teroch/Legends|Teroch]], regarding [[Nam Beroya/Legends|Nam Beroya]] in battle|<ref name="FLT">''[[Friends Like These]]''</ref>}}
'''Frond-grass''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Grass/Legends|grass]] that grew on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Known for its deep green [[Color/Legends|coloration]], frond-grass thrived in [[Water/Legends|moist]] areas. In a [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]] alleyway near the [[Kelita River]], frond-grass grew plentifully in the cracks between the stones that were constantly wet from the spray of the fast-moving river.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
Frond-grass was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] novel, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[October 27]], [[2009]].<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> Frond-grass was later mentioned in the [[roleplaying game]] adventure book ''[[Friends Like These]]'', published on [[December 8]], [[2016]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="FLT" />
